name: Kempinski Hotel Riga
insider_take: Where Baltic elegance meets timeless luxury in the heart of Riga's UNESCO World Heritage Old Town.
whats_special: This sophisticated retreat occupies a prime position steps from Riga's stunning Art Nouveau district—home to the world's largest collection of Art Nouveau architecture. The hotel seamlessly blends contemporary luxury with the city's rich medieval heritage, offering guests an authentic taste of Baltic culture while maintaining Kempinski's legendary European hospitality standards.
pro_tip: Book a corner room facing the Old Town for breathtaking views of the medieval spires and cobblestone streets, especially magical during Riga's famous white nights in summer.
dont_miss: Take a guided Art Nouveau walking tour starting right from the hotel—Riga boasts over 750 Art Nouveau buildings, more per capita than any other city. Also explore the nearby House of the Blackheads, a stunning Gothic guild hall that's become Riga's most photographed landmark, just a 3-minute stroll from your doorstep.
pros: Prime Old Town location with easy access to historic attractions
Luxurious accommodations with elegant European design
Outstanding fine dining restaurants and bars
cons: Historic building may have limited parking availability
